{"summary": "Implemented max_sum_increasing_subseq using O(index^2) DP for the maximum-sum strictly increasing subsequence within the prefix that can precede a[k], excluding elements between index and k.", "files": {"solution.py": """"Write a function to find the maximum sum of increasing subsequence from prefix till ith index and also including a given kth element which is after i, i.e., k > i ."""


def max_sum_increasing_subseq(a, n, index, k):
    """Write a function to find the maximum sum of increasing subsequence from prefix till ith index and also including a given kth element which is after i, i.e., k > i ."""
    kth_value = a[k]

    # Only the prefix a[0] .. a[index] (inclusive) may be used, in
    # addition to a[k].  Elements strictly between index and k are
    # not part of the prefix and must not be used.
    upper = index + 1
    if n is not None:
        upper = min(upper, n)
    upper = min(upper, len(a))
    if k >= 0:
        upper = min(upper, k)

    # msis[j] is the maximum sum of a strictly increasing subsequence
    # within the prefix that ends at (and includes) a[j].
    msis = []
    # Sum contributed by the best such subsequence whose last element
    # is < a[k], so that a[k] can follow it.  The empty subsequence
    # (sum 0) is allowed, so a[k] alone is always a candidate.
    best_before_k = 0
    for j in range(upper):
        value = a[j]
        ending_here = value
        for t in range(j):
            if a[t] < value:
                ending_here = max(ending_here, msis[t] + value)
        msis.append(ending_here)
        if value < kth_value and ending_here > best_before_k:
            best_before_k = ending_here

    return kth_value + best_before_k
